about.title: A focused team for Amazon and e-commerce growth.
paragraphs: PIXEL is a seven-person creative and Amazon agency working across listing images, A+ Content, Brand Story, Storefronts, PPC, KDP, Shopify creative and short-form video.

Our approach combines marketplace awareness with strong visual communication: what shoppers notice first, what needs explanation, what builds trust, and how every asset should work together as one brand system.
